fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the affiliation: `a` and eight hex digits of a hash made once from person, organisation and years when the row is created, and kept when the row changes. The citations refer to it.

fields.name: person
fields.description: The id of the person in the people register.

fields.name: organisation
fields.description: The id of the organisation in the organisations register.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The first year the person belonged to the organisation.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The last year the person belonged to the organisation; empty while it lasts.

fields.name: status
fields.description: How the row reads its citations: `stated` they say so; `assumed` a range extended beyond its records, counted where no stated row or bridged year covers the year; `denied` the person did not belong to the organisation in those years, which removes it from the counting; `proposed` a reading a tool produced and nobody has reviewed, never counted.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: The date the source was last checked.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text remarks on the row; for a denied row, the reason.
